posts.content_md:
> **dave battin:** very nice adam .......... keep up the good work!

Thanks Dave, but in my opinion my MBDCGs look too lousy to be published.

Actually the first holo is silver. Made on Jeff's diffusion method-based DIY plate.

It looks better after painting.

![Image](http://www.unipress.waw.pl/~sarzyn/01.gif)

25" exposure, 3-5mW HeNe, 30"development in metol-scorbate, 3' in rehalogenating bleach.

The skull is my first contact copy H2 taken from holographic sticker found on a cell-phones.

The bear is Croatian 5 Kune coin, I kept it (so as the skull) to test epoxy sealing.

greetings

Adam
